_comment: The only knob. Copy this to ~/.claude/lean.config.json (or <project>/.claude/lean.config.json) and edit — the copy inside the plugin is a read-only default that is replaced on every plugin update. Nothing here steers the model; it only fills in the tier table the card prints.

routes._comment: Which tier each signal routes to. For a 2-tier ladder, set order to ["cheap","main"] and point local at main — there is no middle rung to hand it to.

response._comment: terse = answer alone. default = answer plus one line of why per non-obvious call. full = no compression.
